scope: One hypothetical two-year nurse-led outpatient access expansion at ICC; not all HR360 services or a verified funding offer.
costPerspective: Donor cash for a full clinical capacity package. Incremental pharmacy costs are separately displayed as resources; central donor pharmacy share is zero only under an explicit public-payment assumption, not verified reimbursement. No cost offsets deducted.

assumptions.label: Local/current capacity-cost factor
assumptions.basis: 1.25 is a judgmental uplift to 2023 national clinical resource costs, not a measured SF quote or inflation series.

assumptions.label: Two-year primary-care population
assumptions.basis: 171526 / 6 intervention clinics is a trial-scale reference, not ICC's patient count. The 75 monthly treated-patient costing assumption is a different denominator.

assumptions.label: Added medication-years per 10,000 over TWO years
assumptions.basis: Central 8.2 from PROUD adjusted trial result; optimistic 16.4 is a speculative doubling, pessimistic 5.4 is its one-sided lower bound. Cases are not confidence intervals.

assumptions.label: Transfer of trial access effect
assumptions.basis: Further expansion at an existing integrated clinic may do less than introducing a nurse model. This includes alternative treatment displaced; do not discount access twice.

assumptions.label: Funding additionality
assumptions.basis: Probability-equivalent share of the added capacity not supplied by existing public/private funding. Separate from patient-level access transfer.

assumptions.label: Buprenorphine share of extra medication time
assumptions.basis: Judgment: no current ICC drug mix observed. Remaining naltrexone time receives no mortality credit, not a claim of no benefit.

assumptions.label: Out-of-treatment mortality per person-year
assumptions.basis: Central 0.0095 is an older pooled cohort calibration; not measured contemporary SF risk. Higher-risk optimistic case is a judgment.

assumptions.label: In-treatment mortality per person-year
assumptions.basis: Central 0.0043 from the same cohort synthesis; selection/confounding prevent causal interpretation.

assumptions.label: Causal/transport retention of mortality difference
assumptions.basis: Central 50% is an explicit judgment, not an estimated confidence adjustment. No additional overdose-specific benefit is added to all-cause survival.

assumptions.label: Survivor health utility
assumptions.basis: Judgmental shared mortality-model value, not a treatment-induced utility gain.

assumptions.label: Post-prevented-death annual hazard
assumptions.basis: Judgmental conditional survival trajectory after the avoided acute death, not lifetime treatment efficacy.

assumptions.label: Post-event survival horizon
assumptions.basis: 15 years central; future survival discounted at 3% annually. No indefinite medication protection assumed.

assumptions.label: Additional nonfatal utility while covered
assumptions.basis: Analyst best guess 0.03, not a measured local gain or a published utility level. Optimistic 0.10 and pessimistic zero; apply only during added buprenorphine time, not indefinitely.

nullBoundary: Zero additional coverage or full funding substitution gives zero benefit absent extra harm. With coverage, zero mortality benefit and zero nonfatal utility gain together produce zero health benefit. Greater in-treatment mortality or extra cessation-related deaths can produce harm. The pooled out-of-treatment rate already includes cessation periods; extra deaths are a stress test beyond that calibration, not an estimated additive penalty.
overlap: Do not add these benefits to HYA access or SFAF/DOPE rescue benefits for the same person-time and avoided deaths. This rare-event approximation is for one two-year tranche; repeated tranches need a person-level survival model, not fresh independent lifetime credit every year.
